plans.name: Free Trial Week
rules: Your first visit at each studio during the trial is included.
Premium classes and sauna sessions are not included.
A second visit at the same studio needs a credit plan.
The trial ends on its end date; unless you cancel before then it renews into 8 Credits at $59.00.

plans.name: 8 Credits
rules: 8 credits every 30 days; unused credits do not roll over.
Cancel free up to 12 hours before a class; after that the credits are forfeited.

plans.name: 20 Credits
rules: 20 credits every 30 days; unused credits do not roll over.
Cancel free up to 12 hours before a class; after that the credits are forfeited.
